sampling: every real raw frame, action RNG seed+100000, new uniform button every 16 frames
coordinate_convention: xywh, integer pixels, half-open box; center x+w/2,y+h/2
independent_screen_check: fixed Pong sprite palette, bounding extent in play area y=34..193; no RAM, no temporal background/reference code
calibration_rule: each type: >=50 jointly visible frames; >=99% presence agreement; >=99% of jointly visible boxes differ by <=1 pixel on every edge
motion_denominator: currently visible objects with >=2 visible positions and any position change in current and previous 8 real frames within the same episode; no net-displacement shortcut
perception_match: one-to-one, maximize matches within Euclidean center distance <=4px, then minimize distance; match all visible objects before filtering moving recall
hud: outside y=34..193 excluded by evaluator for truths and detections; reference receives full RGB with no labels
empty_denominator: null with explicit numerator and denominator, never perfect by default
score_validation: not covered by object calibration; may not support competence claims until independently checked
validation: correct on development if necessary and record failed baseline; seal corrected decoder before opening reserved validation labels
agent_access: fixtures, RAM, semantic palette, object names and results remain experimenter-side
